Display

Text
Zen Kaku Gothic New OFL
Moves
airy setting, vertical type, serif display
Mood
calm, poetic, airy, precise
Case
Latin in sentence case; Japanese title set vertically (writing-mode: vertical-rl) with +0.18 em tracking.
Numerals and features
font-feature-settings: "palt" 1; text-orientation: mixed

静かな朝、お茶を一杯。静かな朝、お茶を一杯。

palt tightens Japanese punctuation to proportional widths in horizontal lines; leave it off in vertical setting.
Signature
A vertical Japanese title standing at the right edge, a short Latin line far away at the lower left, and 60 percent of the screen left empty on purpose.
Use when
Tea, ceramics, ryokan and small hotels, meditation, poetry and slow-living brands, Japanese bilingual sites.
Turns into slop when
When Japanese is used as decoration on a product that has no Japanese link, when cherry blossoms and torii are drawn in, or when the vertical text is a fake rotated image.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
